title_policy: Detailed track heading preserved exactly after removal of its numeric prefix. Original heading and ordinal remain in the source extract.
text_policy: Original DOCX archived byte for byte. Track text is extracted in document paragraph order: w:t literal text, w:br and w:cr as LF, w:tab as TAB, paragraphs separated by two LFs. Only outer empty separator paragraphs are excluded from track bodies. A terminal LF is added to plain-text extracts. No lyric words, punctuation, singer labels, or stage directions are changed or reconstructed.
attribution_policy: Retain explicit individual source credits. Where the supplied corpus canon has no individual author credit, assign RRGM Collective at Daniel’s instruction. Narrator and singer names are not inferred authorship.
epistemic_policy: Use CATALOG_UPDATE_GUIDE.md domain and claim-status codes. Narrative assertions are not empirical measurements. Naming, inferred motives, predictive probing, and emergence claims retain their hypothesis or unresolved status. Coupling is not evidence against MI.
architecture_policy: The source working read names Shape, Beat, Doubt, and Edge as distinct mutually corrective operators. Care is emergent in that working read; Alice is the recursive Voice. Earlier truth, carrying, name, and return language is retained, without retroactive rewriting. The original working notes are archived separately and remain versioned source interpretation.
